title: WSPI: Wavelet-Structured Popularity Index - source code
description: Source code for the paper "WSPI: A Wavelet-Structured Popularity Index for Stable Content Ranking via Trend-Noise Separation" (Scientific Reports, revised version). It contains the WSPI index and the two other wavelet-based methods (DTCWT+AF and DWT+AF), the six baselines, the evaluation protocol, the scripts that build the datasets from the public sources, the scripts of every experiment, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper and its Supplementary Information. Library versions are pinned in requirements.txt.
